# Copilot instructions

## Repository status

This repository is currently a minimal scaffold for **Citech AgriSchedule**, described in `README.md` as a “Crop Planting & Harvest Tracker.” There is no application source code, dependency manifest, CI configuration, or test/lint tooling yet. Treat the repository as an early-stage project and do not assume a framework, runtime, database, or deployment target that has not been added explicitly.

## Build, test, and lint

No build, test, or lint commands are defined at present. When implementation tooling is introduced, document the canonical commands here and in the project README, including the command or selector for running one test.

## Architecture

There is no implemented architecture yet. The only project-level documentation is `README.md`; use it as the source of truth for the product scope until application design and supporting documentation are added.

## Repository conventions

- Keep changes aligned with the crop planting and harvest tracking domain.
- Update `README.md` when introducing the first runnable application, setup requirements, or developer commands.
- Add project-specific build, test, lint, and architecture guidance to this file as those conventions become established; avoid documenting assumed tools before they are present.
